records.text: Charlie Kirk did not appoint Erika Kirk as CEO at the Aspen event, and the purported recording was AI-generated.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep SKNJPul29zU)

appearances.snippet: AI of Charlie (Charlie Kirk) saying I appoint Erika (Erika Kirk) to be the CEO Erika (Erika Kirk) told me that he said that at an Aspen event I was okay great well the Aspen people who were at the event said that never happened these are the turning point USA donors who have contacted me and said Candace that is AI he did not say that Say

verification.notes: Anonymous donors and event attendees allegedly dispute the Aspen remark, but no complete original recording, authenticated forensic analysis, or named witness record was located. The AI-generation allegation therefore cannot be resolved.

conveyance.original_source: Communications from Turning Point USA donors and Aspen event attendees
